VERDICT goal: the node goal is to free a launch reservation whose attempt never reached its worker; reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2454 _unreached_launch releases a reservation naming no supervisor, whose attempt left no worker record, past UNREACHED_LAUNCH_BOUND_SECONDS, and reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2754 _record_unreached_launch files the attempt receipt on every path that ends a launch before its supervisor, so the goal is met.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names four cases in tests/test_a_launch_that_never_reached_its_worker_frees_its_hold.py plus matched importing arms, a negative control and ruff; the file carries five cases covering those four, gate-base.log records 51 passed EXIT=0, gate-after.log 56 passed EXIT=0, importing-base.log 23 failed/658 passed and importing-after.log 23 failed/663 passed with only the two named floaters differing, and negative-control.log 1 failed/4 passed EXIT=1 — every figure read from the log on disk.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py, tests/test_a_launch_that_never_reached_its_worker_frees_its_hold.py, the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/a-dispatch-returns-without-its-worker/ and an unused figures directory; the diff touches only the first three and nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records status complete, the three commits, each arm's log path, the base arm's scaffolding failure attributed and re-run in a git worktree, and the ruff delta; I checked each figure against its log and re-ran the named test file at head in a scratch tree (5 passed EXIT=0).

CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2967 (dispatch reserves the launch attempt), reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3666 (the fresh dispatch starts its supervisor and records the reservation's supervisor), reckon/crew/resumption.py:1802 (a resume reserves the launch attempt), reckon/crew/resumption.py:1528 (a resume launches through supervised_launch, so it passes the fence)

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2484 returns not-held for the reported shape (live pid, supervisor_pid null, no worker record, past the bound) and :2754 writes the receipt that frees the raising case, so the goal is met, though the goal's safety claim holds only on the supervised_launch path.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-after.log at 55b64132d9 records 56 passed EXIT=0 and gate-base.log at 05684b28df 51 passed EXIT=0, the new cases assert the done_when's four shapes, and I reproduced the declared mutation red (1 failed, 1 EXIT=1); the recorded control reverted only the age reading, not the receipt, so it exercises one of the two cases the plan names, and the plan's station-stderr investigation is recorded only as the run-directory facts in the manifest's evidence_inputs.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in `git diff --stat 05684b28df..cdfe803166` — reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py, the new test file and the fragment — is inside the manifest's orientation_write_paths, and no other file changed.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: I reinstated each regression in a scratch tree at head and each guarding case reddened — the base reading reddens test_a_stale_reservation_naming_a_live_pid_is_not_held_and_a_relaunch_is_admitted, dropping the receipt call reddens test_a_launch_that_raises_leaves_its_exit_receipt_and_frees_the_hold, and dropping the fence reddens test_a_launch_whose_attempt_was_retaken_starts_no_supervisor; the one weak assertion is at tests/test_a_launch_that_never_reached_its_worker_frees_its_hold.py:232.
SCORE fit: 16
JUSTIFICATION fit: the changes follow the module's shape — UNREACHED_LAUNCH_BOUND_SECONDS sits beside STEP_WAIT_CEILING_SECONDS at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:4427 and the helpers are private with mechanism names — but the docstring at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2469 cites a fence name that exists nowhere.
SCORE reuse: 18
JUSTIFICATION reuse: a search of reckon/crew for an owner of an age-bounded reservation release found none — refuse_a_released_launch at reckon/crew/dispatch_refusals.py:284 refuses on the span record, not a reservation, and _record_holds_a_worker at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2109 answers a different question (any attempt's receipts from a pointer) — so the added helpers extend no owner but duplicate none.
FINDING reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2469 non-blocking: the docstring states that the fence "in :func:`_launch_still_newest` is what makes the release safe", but no such symbol exists in the module — the fence is _refuse_superseded_launch at line 2773 — so a reader chasing the safety argument is sent to nothing.
FINDING reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3666 non-blocking: the age release admits a relaunch while a fresh dispatch is still stalled, and that path starts its supervisor without re-reading the launch reservation (it re-reads only the span release at :3665), so a revived fresh dispatch and its relaunch can both spawn a supervisor for one run; the repair belongs to the node that owns dispatch.py, which this node was not fenced to write.
FINDING tests/test_a_launch_that_never_reached_its_worker_frees_its_hold.py:232 non-blocking: the assertion compares held["supervisor_pid"] with the supervisor pid the test itself wrote into the reservation at :227, so the two sides move together; the load-bearing guard in that case is the preceding held-is-not-None assertion.
